summary: No concrete installer-harm evidence in amanexzyra-baileys@4.0.0
details: No malicious behavior was observed in this version of the package. The name resembles forks of the popular WhatsApp library family (Baileys), which is a category that has historically seen typosquat and trojanized forks, but name similarity alone is not sufficient to classify this version as a supply-chain attack. No exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, credential distribution, dropper, or backdoor was identified in the package's contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
